reason_for_revision: Full review of the six v2 plans found valid structure and constraints but weak motivational contrast. Most candidates still prioritize quiet unhurried city/history trips, measured voices and practical moderation; differing age/state/job labels do not establish the targeted diversity.
acceptance: Full original constraints, coherent final biographies, preservation of selected sketch, and meaningful variation in desired experiences or organizing social commitments. No content-based redraws. Shared ordinary preferences and repeated random selections are allowed; superficial demographic changes alone do not pass.
stopping_rule: After this bounded batch, preserve the best verified procedure and report remaining limitations. Do not keep changing prose indefinitely or relabel unresolved sampling/calibration as solved.
limitations: Two calls per profile, deliberately contrasting proposals, uncalibrated model-defined distribution. Independent pipelines share no history, but are not representative population samples.
